The '''"Multi Imager" dedicated energy receptor''' was a model of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] manufactured by [[Melihat/Legends|Melihat]]. It was part of the primary [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] aboard [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. It was used in conjunction with a [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]] [[universal transceiver package]], a [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[ANs-5d "lock track" full-spectrum transceiver]], and a [[Tana Ire/Legends|Tana Ire]] [[electro photo receptor]].<ref name="SWS" />
